items.statement_en: CISH states that Allahabad Safeda and Sardar (L-49) are the mainstay of the Indian guava industry because of high yield, quality and wide market acceptance.

items.statement_en: Lalit is a high-yielding pink-fleshed guava released by ICAR-CISH Lucknow and is suited to both table and processing use.
items.statement_hi: ललित सीआईएसएच लखनऊ द्वारा जारी अधिक उपज वाली गुलाबी गूदे की अमरूद किस्म है, जो ताजा खाने और प्रसंस्करण दोनों के लिए उपयुक्त है।

items.statement_en: CISH reports that the area under Lalit has increased significantly in Maharashtra (also Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka).
items.statement_hi: सीआईएसएच के अनुसार महाराष्ट्र (तथा आंध्र प्रदेश और कर्नाटक) में ललित का क्षेत्रफल काफी बढ़ा है।

items.statement_en: Shweta, developed by ICAR-CISH Lucknow, is a semi-vigorous tree of medium height and a prolific bearer.
items.statement_hi: सीआईएसएच लखनऊ द्वारा विकसित श्वेता का पेड़ अर्ध-ओजस्वी, मध्यम ऊँचाई का और भरपूर फलने वाला है।

sources.title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
sources.publisher: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow
sources.quote: Tree is semi-vigorous with medium height and is a prolific bearer.

items.statement_en: Arka Kiran (ICAR-IIHR) has pink pulp, average fruit weight of 200-220 g and medium soft seeds.
items.statement_hi: अर्का किरण (आईसीएआर-आईआईएचआर) में गुलाबी गूदा, औसत फल वजन 200-220 ग्राम और मध्यम मुलायम बीज होते हैं।

sources.title: Guava - Arka Kiran
sources.publisher: ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research, Bengaluru
sources.quote: It is a pink pulp variety with average fruit weight of 200-220g with medium soft seeds (9 kg/cm2).

items.statement_en: IIHR states Arka Kiran can be harvested two years after planting, with economic yield from year five at about 20 t per acre at 4 m x 3 m spacing. This is a breeder claim and is far above CISH's 12-20 t per ha for traditional orchards; it needs expert review.
items.statement_hi: आईआईएचआर के अनुसार अर्का किरण में रोपाई के दो साल बाद फल मिलने लगते हैं और पाँचवें वर्ष से 4 मी x 3 मी दूरी पर लगभग 20 टन प्रति एकड़ आर्थिक उपज मिलती है। यह प्रजनक का दावा है और विशेषज्ञ समीक्षा आवश्यक है।

sources.title: Guava - Arka Kiran
sources.publisher: ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research, Bengaluru
sources.quote: Economic yield starts after five years with average fruit yield of 20 t/acre in a spacing of 4m x 3m.

conflicts.quote: Average yield is 12-20 t ha-I
conflicts.note: CISH table gives 12-20 t per ha (about 5-8 t per acre) for the traditional system; the Arka Kiran figure is much higher per unit area.

items.statement_en: Allahabad Safeda fruit is medium sized, round, with smooth skin and white flesh.
items.statement_hi: इलाहाबाद सफेदा का फल मध्यम आकार का, गोल, चिकनी त्वचा और सफेद गूदे वाला होता है।

sources.title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
sources.publisher: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow
sources.section_or_table: Commercial and Improved Varieties, Allahabad Safeda
sources.quote: Fruit is of medium size, round in shape with smooth skin and white flesh.

items.statement_en: Sardar (L-49) fruit is large, round to ovate, with primrose-yellow skin and white flesh; seeds are plentiful.
items.statement_hi: सरदार (एल-49) का फल बड़ा, गोल से अंडाकार, हल्के पीले छिलके और सफेद गूदे वाला होता है; बीज अधिक होते हैं।

sources.title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
sources.publisher: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow
sources.quote: Fruit is large, round to ovate in shape, primrose-yellow skin colour, white flesh and seeds are in plenty

items.statement_en: CISH names further improved varieties released by ICAR institutes or state universities: Shweta, Pant Prabhat, Dhareedar, Arka Mridula, Arka Amulya, Safed Jam, Kohir Safeda, Hisar Surkha, Hisar Safeda and Allahabad Surkha.
items.statement_hi: सीआईएसएच के अनुसार आईसीएआर संस्थानों या राज्य विश्वविद्यालयों द्वारा जारी अन्य उन्नत किस्में: श्वेता, पंत प्रभात, धारीदार, अर्का मृदुला, अर्का अमूल्या, सफेद जाम, कोहिर सफेदा, हिसार सुरखा, हिसार सफेदा और इलाहाबाद सुरखा।

items.statement_en: TNAU lists Allahabad, Lucknow 46, Lucknow 49, Arka Amulya, Arka Mridula, Banaras, Baptla, Arka Kiran, Lalit and TRY (G)-1 as suitable varieties. This is a Tamil Nadu list, kept as a cross-check only.
items.statement_hi: टीएनएयू के अनुसार इलाहाबाद, लखनऊ 46, लखनऊ 49, अर्का अमूल्या, अर्का मृदुला, बनारस, बापटला, अर्का किरण, ललित और टीआरवाई (जी)-1 उपयुक्त किस्में हैं। यह तमिलनाडु की सूची है, केवल मिलान हेतु।

sources.title: Horticulture :: Fruits :: Guava (Agritech portal)
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
sources.quote: Allahabad, Lucknow 46, 49, Arka Amulya, Arka Mridula, Banaras, Baptla, Arka Kiran, Lalit and TRY (G)-1 are the suitable varieties for cultivation.

items.statement_en: NHB says guava grows in tropical and sub-tropical regions up to 1,500 m above sea level. TNAU and TNAU course notes give 1,000 m.
items.statement_hi: एनएचबी के अनुसार अमरूद उष्ण और उपोष्ण क्षेत्रों में समुद्र तल से 1,500 मी तक उगता है। टीएनएयू 1,000 मी बताता है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: Guava is grown in both tropical and sub-tropical regions upto 1,500 m. above m.s.l.

conflicts.source_title: Horticulture :: Fruits :: Guava (Agritech portal)
conflicts.quote: It can be grown upto 1000 m altitude.
conflicts.note: TNAU gives 1,000 m instead of 1,500 m.

conflicts.source_title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
conflicts.quote: enjoys cooler climate upto an elevation of 1000 m but it cannot withstand frost.
conflicts.note: TNAU course notes also give 1,000 m.

items.statement_en: Severe frost can kill young guava plants.
items.statement_hi: तेज पाला अमरूद के छोटे पौधों को मार सकता है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: However, it is susceptible to severe frost as it can kill the young plants.

items.statement_en: Guava tolerates the high temperatures and drought of north Indian summers.
items.statement_hi: अमरूद उत्तर भारत की गर्मियों के उच्च तापमान और सूखे को सहन कर लेता है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: It tolerates high temperatures and drought conditions prevalent in north India in summers.

items.statement_en: About 100 cm of annual rainfall in the rainy season (July-September) is sufficient for guava.
items.statement_hi: वर्षा ऋतु (जुलाई-सितंबर) में लगभग 100 सेमी वार्षिक वर्षा अमरूद के लिए पर्याप्त है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: An annual rainfall of about 100 cm. is sufficient during the rainy season (July-September).

items.statement_en: Rain during the harvest period lowers fruit quality.
items.statement_hi: कटाई के समय वर्षा से फलों की गुणवत्ता घटती है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: Rainfall during the harvesting period deteriorates the quality of fruits.

items.statement_en: NHB and Vikaspedia consider soil from heavy clay to very light sandy, with pH 4.5 to 8.2, suitable for guava. TNAU course notes give an upper pH of 7.5.
items.statement_hi: एनएचबी और विकासपीडिया के अनुसार भारी चिकनी से बहुत हल्की रेतीली मिट्टी, pH 4.5 से 8.2, अमरूद के लिए उपयुक्त है। टीएनएयू नोट्स में ऊपरी pH 7.5 है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: Heavy clay to very light sandy soils having pH between 4.5-8.2 are suitable for cultivation of guava.

sources.title: Guava monthly crop calendar (Vikaspedia)
sources.publisher: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India knowledge portal)
sources.quote: Based on soil test report, even if the soil PH is up to 8.2 it is considered as suitable for guava plantation.

conflicts.quote: It can grow in soils with pH ranging from 4.5 to 7.5 but the best soils are deep, friable and well drained.
conflicts.note: Upper limit 7.5 instead of 8.2.

items.statement_en: Guava is sensitive to waterlogging.
items.statement_hi: अमरूद जलभराव के प्रति संवेदनशील है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: The crop is sensitive to water-logging.

items.statement_en: Guava needs a distinct winter to develop good quality and cannot withstand frost.
items.statement_hi: अच्छी गुणवत्ता के लिए अमरूद को स्पष्ट सर्दी चाहिए और यह पाला सहन नहीं कर सकता।

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: It is a subtropical and tropical fruit which requires a distinct winter for developing good quality.

items.statement_en: Avoid sites where the soil profile shows lime nodules or sheet rock.
items.statement_hi: जिस मिट्टी की परत में चूने की गाँठें या चट्टान हो, वहाँ बाग न लगाएँ।

sources.title: Guava monthly crop calendar (Vikaspedia)
sources.publisher: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India knowledge portal)
sources.quote: If the lime nodules or sheet rock is present avoid such soils for taking up plantations.

items.statement_en: TNAU advises 3 kg gypsum per plant at planting and once every three years for saline soils. Tamil Nadu advice; not verified for MP or MH soils.
items.statement_hi: टीएनएयू लवणीय मिट्टी में रोपाई पर और फिर हर तीन वर्ष में 3 किग्रा जिप्सम प्रति पौधा देने की सलाह देता है। यह तमिलनाडु की सलाह है; मप्र/महाराष्ट्र के लिए सत्यापित नहीं।

items.statement_en: NHB says planting is done in the rainy season and June-July is the ideal time for layers and seedlings. TNAU says June to December; CISH says any time of year if irrigation is available.
items.statement_hi: एनएचबी के अनुसार रोपाई वर्षा ऋतु में होती है और जून-जुलाई कलम व पौधों के लिए सर्वोत्तम समय है। टीएनएयू जून से दिसंबर और सीआईएसएच सिंचाई हो तो वर्ष भर बताता है।

items.statement_en: NHB says dig 1 m x 1 m x 1 m pits before the monsoon and fill with farmyard manure and soil. Other sources use smaller pits, from 45 cm to 75 cm.

items.statement_en: Legumes or vegetables can be intercropped for the first three years if irrigation is available. NHB's cost model counts intercrop income up to year four.
items.statement_hi: सिंचाई उपलब्ध हो तो पहले तीन वर्ष दलहनी फसलें या सब्जियाँ अंतरफसल के रूप में उगाई जा सकती हैं। एनएचबी का मॉडल चौथे वर्ष तक अंतरफसल आय मानता है।

items.statement_en: A cited study (Ravishankar et al. 2008, summarised by Sonawane) found 6 m x 3 m (555 plants per ha) gave the highest productivity of Allahabad Safeda by year six under North Coorg conditions. Karnataka evidence, secondhand.
items.statement_hi: सोनवणे द्वारा उद्धृत एक अध्ययन में उत्तरी कूर्ग परिस्थितियों में 6x3 मी (555 पौधे/हेक्टेयर) पर इलाहाबाद सफेदा की छठे वर्ष तक सर्वाधिक उत्पादकता मिली। कर्नाटक का द्वितीयक प्रमाण।

sources.title: Improvement in the guava production technology - an overview

items.statement_en: NHB says guava plants are propagated vegetatively by budding, inarching or air layering. TNAU says layers are the planting material.
items.statement_hi: एनएचबी के अनुसार अमरूद के पौधे कलिकायन, इनार्चिंग या गूटी (एयर लेयरिंग) से वानस्पतिक रूप से तैयार किए जाते हैं। टीएनएयू के अनुसार गूटी कलम रोपण सामग्री है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: Plants are vegetatively propagated by budding, inarching or air layering.

sources.title: Horticulture :: Fruits :: Guava (Agritech portal)
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
sources.quote: Layers are used as planting material.

items.statement_en: Seed-raised guava trees bear later and differ greatly from the mother plant, so layering is recommended instead. Seed is used only to raise rootstock.
items.statement_hi: बीज से तैयार अमरूद देर से फलता है और मातृ पौधे से काफी भिन्न होता है, इसलिए गूटी कलम की सलाह है। बीज केवल मूलवृंत बनाने में उपयोग होता है।

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: seedlings will take more time to come to bearing and seedling trees differ greatly from the mother plants

sources.title: Improvement in the guava production technology - an overview
sources.publisher: Review Of Research (lbp.world), Y.C. Maharashtra Open University author
sources.quote: seed propagation is followed only for raising rootstock.

items.statement_en: Layers can be separated from the mother plant in about 45 days.
items.statement_hi: गूटी कलम लगभग 45 दिन में मातृ पौधे से अलग की जा सकती है।

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: In about 45 days, layers can be separated from the mother plants.

items.statement_en: Separated layers are potted and hardened by gradually exposing them to direct sunlight; they are ready for planting in about six months.
items.statement_hi: अलग की गई कलमों को गमलों में लगाकर धीरे-धीरे सीधी धूप में कठोर किया जाता है; वे लगभग छह माह में रोपाई योग्य हो जाती हैं।

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: Such hardened layers are ready for planting in about six months.

items.statement_en: Semi-hard wood cuttings are hard to root, but IBA or NAA at 2,000-5,000 ppm roots them under mist conditions (TNAU course notes).
items.statement_hi: अर्ध-कठोर कलमों में जड़ें निकालना कठिन है, पर मिस्ट में आईबीए या एनएए 2,000-5,000 पीपीएम से जड़ें निकलती हैं (टीएनएयू नोट्स)।

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: treating with IBA or NAA at 2000 to 5000 ppm root well under mist conditions

items.statement_en: For high-density planting a dwarf rootstock 'Pusa Srijan' is recommended at 3 m x 3 m and is tolerant to guava wilt (review summary).
items.statement_hi: उच्च घनत्व रोपण के लिए बौना मूलवृंत 'पूसा सृजन' 3x3 मी पर अनुशंसित है और उकठा रोग सहनशील है (समीक्षा सारांश)।

sources.title: Improvement in the guava production technology - an overview
sources.publisher: Review Of Research (lbp.world), Y.C. Maharashtra Open University author
sources.quote: For high density plantation in guava a dwarf rootstock, ‘Pusa Srijan’ is recommended for planting at 3m x 3m. This rootstock is tolerant to guava wilt.

items.statement_en: Commercially guava is mainly propagated by tongue layering, air layering, inarch grafting and stooling (mound layering).
items.statement_hi: व्यावसायिक रूप से अमरूद मुख्यतः टंग लेयरिंग, एयर लेयरिंग, इनार्च ग्राफ्टिंग और स्टूलिंग (मिट्टी चढ़ाकर) से तैयार होता है।

sources.title: Improvement in the guava production technology - an overview
sources.publisher: Review Of Research (lbp.world), Y.C. Maharashtra Open University author
sources.quote: For commercial purpose, guava is mainly propagated by tongue layering, air layering, and inarch grafting and stooling, i. e. mound layering.

items.statement_en: Buy planting material from reliable nurseries, preferably government nurseries or those recommended by the horticulture department.
items.statement_hi: रोपण सामग्री विश्वसनीय नर्सरी से, अधिमानतः सरकारी या उद्यान विभाग द्वारा अनुशंसित नर्सरी से लें।

sources.title: Guava monthly crop calendar (Vikaspedia)
sources.publisher: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India knowledge portal)
sources.quote: Make arrangements for procurement of plant material from reliable nurseries preferably from Govt. nurseries or from nurseries recommended by department of horticulture.

items.statement_en: Guava has three bahar (flowering and fruiting) seasons: Ambe, Mrig and Hasta (spelled Hasth in the source).
items.statement_hi: अमरूद में तीन बहार (फूल-फल के मौसम) होते हैं: अंबे, मृग और हस्त।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: Guava fruit bears three bahar seasons, viz., Ambe bahar, Mrig bahar, and Hasth bahar.

items.statement_en: The heaviest flowering is in Ambe bahar, but its fruit is rough, watery and insipid.
items.statement_hi: अंबे बहार में सबसे अधिक फूल आते हैं, पर इसके फल खुरदुरे, पनीले और फीके होते हैं।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: the heaviest flowering is observed in the Ambe bahar, but the fruit quality of this season is rough, watery, insipid in taste

items.statement_en: The winter crop is better in quality and fetches a higher price than the rainy-season crop. NHB says farmers reduce the monsoon crop by deblossoming to get a better price.
items.statement_hi: सर्दी की फसल गुणवत्ता में बेहतर होती है और बरसात की फसल से ऊँचा भाव पाती है। एनएचबी के अनुसार किसान बेहतर भाव के लिए बरसाती फूल हटाते हैं।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: Winter season crop is superior in quality which fetches higher prices than rainy season crop.

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: The winter crop is much superior in quality compared to the monsoon crop.

items.statement_en: In the rainy season fruit flies attack seriously and can make fruit unfit to eat, one reason to avoid the rainy crop.
items.statement_hi: बरसात में फल मक्खी का गंभीर प्रकोप होता है और फल खाने योग्य नहीं रहते, इसलिए बरसाती फसल से बचने की सलाह है।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: In rainy season there is a serious attack of fruit flies which deteriorates its quality and fruits become unfit for human consumption.

items.statement_en: Withholding water, exposing feeder roots and pruning fibrous roots to force flowering in the chosen season are practised in Maharashtra and the Deccan plateau belt. Exact dates for Maharashtra were not found (see gaps).
items.statement_hi: महाराष्ट्र और दक्कन पठार क्षेत्र में पानी रोकना, जड़ें खोलना और रेशेदार जड़ें काटकर इच्छित मौसम में फूल लाना प्रचलित है। महाराष्ट्र की सटीक तिथियाँ नहीं मिलीं।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: to force blossom in the desired season are practiced in Maharashtra and Deccan plateau growing belt of guava in India.

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: In certain parts of Maharashtra, root pruning is practiced to produce heavy yield.

items.statement_en: Root pruning harms tree longevity, so it is a trade-off for crop regulation.
items.statement_hi: जड़ों की छंटाई पेड़ की आयु पर बुरा प्रभाव डालती है, इसलिए यह फसल नियमन में समझौते वाला उपाय है।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: Root pruning, however has a harmful effect on the longevity of trees

items.statement_en: To get a winter crop, the basin is dug up, manured and irrigated in June; after 20-25 days of fertigation the tree flowers profusely in July and fruits in winter.
items.statement_hi: सर्दी की फसल के लिए जून में थाला खोदकर खाद दी जाती है और सिंचाई की जाती है; 20-25 दिन बाद जुलाई में खूब फूल आते हैं और सर्दी में फल मिलते हैं।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: After 20-25 days of fertigation, the tree offers profuse flowering in July and fruiting in the winter season.

items.statement_en: An older recommendation (Howes et al. 1955, cited in the review) is to withhold water and remove earth from the upper roots by 10 June, then cover with soil and manure.
items.statement_hi: एक पुरानी सिफारिश (हॉवेस 1955, समीक्षा में उद्धृत) है कि 10 जून तक पानी रोककर ऊपरी जड़ों से मिट्टी हटाएँ, फिर मिट्टी और खाद से ढक दें।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: withholding of water and removing the earth from around the upper roots by 10th June and again covering it with soil and manure mixture

items.statement_en: Branch bending, trialled in Odisha, keeps 10-15 leaf pairs at the tip and removes other leaves, flowers and fruits before bending. Not tested in MP or MH.
items.statement_hi: ओडिशा में परीक्षित शाखा झुकाव में सिरे पर 10-15 पत्ती-जोड़े रखकर बाकी पत्तियाँ, फूल और फल हटाकर शाखा झुकाई जाती है। मप्र/महाराष्ट्र में परीक्षित नहीं।

sources.publisher: Journal of the Indian Society of Coastal Agricultural Research 34(1):92-96 (ICAR-IIHR CHES Bhubaneswar authors)
sources.quote: Branch bending was done by retaining 10-15 pairs of leaves at apex and removing all the leaves, flowers and developing fruits manually

items.statement_en: In the Odisha trial branch bending induced winter flowering (46.27%) and the highest winter yield (26.48 kg per plant), while summer pruning did not improve it.
items.statement_hi: ओडिशा के परीक्षण में शाखा झुकाव से सर्दी में 46.27% फूल आए और सर्वाधिक उपज (26.48 किग्रा/पौधा) मिली, जबकि ग्रीष्म कटाई से सुधार नहीं हुआ।

sources.title: Branch Bending for Crop Regulation in Guava under Hot and Humid Climate of Eastern India
sources.publisher: Journal of the Indian Society of Coastal Agricultural Research 34(1):92-96 (ICAR-IIHR CHES Bhubaneswar authors)
sources.quote: under hot and humid climate of eastern India, branch bending could be adopted as a technology to regulate cropping in guava

items.statement_hi: ओडिशा परीक्षण में ग्रीष्मकालीन शाखा कटाई (30, 50, 70%) से सर्दी की फसल नहीं सुधरी और कुल उपज नियंत्रण से घटी।

sources.publisher: Journal of the Indian Society of Coastal Agricultural Research 34(1):92-96 (ICAR-IIHR CHES Bhubaneswar authors)
sources.quote: did not yield any positive impact on regulation of winter crop

items.statement_en: Branches are bent down about 45-60 days before the expected flowering date to get off-season fruit.
items.statement_hi: बेमौसमी फल के लिए अपेक्षित फूल आने की तिथि से लगभग 45-60 दिन पहले शाखाएँ झुकाई जाती हैं।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: the branches of guava plants are bent down about 45-60 days before the expected date of flowering to produce fruits in the off season.

items.statement_en: Branch bending should start when the plant is two years old.
items.statement_hi: शाखा झुकाव पौधे की दो वर्ष की आयु से शुरू करना चाहिए।

sources.title: Optimizing yield and quality in guava through crop regulation: comprehensive review
sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: Initially, bending of branches of guava plants ought to be done at the age of two years of the plant.

items.statement_en: Guava flowers only on new, vigorously emerging shoots, so crop regulation works by controlling when new shoots appear. TNAU notes say flowers sit in leaf axils of the current season's growth.
items.statement_hi: अमरूद में फूल केवल नई, तेजी से निकलने वाली शाखाओं पर आते हैं, इसलिए फसल नियमन नई शाखाओं के निकलने का समय नियंत्रित करता है।

sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)
sources.quote: guava flowers are borne only on new, succulent, vigorously emerging vegetative growths.

sources.title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: The flowers are borne on the current season growth in the axils of leaves.

items.statement_en: TNAU course notes say guava flowers in April-May for the rainy crop and August-September for the winter crop. This differs from Odisha data (March-April and July-August).

conflicts.quote: (March-April) and rainy (July-August)
conflicts.note: Odisha trial reports spring flowering in March-April and rainy flowering in July-August; text extracted with italic splits.

items.statement_en: Post-bloom NAA at 80-100 ppm has reduced fruit set in the review. NHB confirms NAA, NAD and 2,4-D can thin flowers. Other sources give 200-400 ppm or 600 ppm. HIGH risk: needs an expert and a CIB&RC check.
items.statement_hi: समीक्षा में फूल आने के बाद एनएए 80-100 पीपीएम से फल-बैठना घटा। एनएचबी भी एनएए, एनएडी और 2,4-डी से फूल विरलन बताता है। अन्य स्रोत 200-400 या 600 पीपीएम देते हैं। उच्च जोखिम: विशेषज्ञ और सीआईबी एंड आरसी जाँच आवश्यक।

items.statement_en: A 2,4-D spray at 30 ppm was reported effective for de-blossoming summer flowers. HIGH risk: needs an expert and a CIB&RC check.
items.statement_hi: 2,4-डी का 30 पीपीएम छिड़काव गर्मी के फूल हटाने में प्रभावी बताया गया। उच्च जोखिम: विशेषज्ञ और सीआईबी एंड आरसी जाँच आवश्यक।

sources.publisher: Indian Journal of Arid Horticulture 7(2) (ICAR-CSSRI Karnal authors)

items.statement_en: Urea at 15% sprayed at 50% bloom was reported most effective for de-blossoming the rainy-season crop (Choudhary et al. 1997, cited in the review). HIGH risk: needs expert review.
items.statement_hi: 50% फूल अवस्था पर 15% यूरिया छिड़काव बरसाती फसल के फूल हटाने में सबसे प्रभावी बताया गया (चौधरी 1997)। उच्च जोखिम: विशेषज्ञ समीक्षा आवश्यक।

items.statement_hi: बरसात के फूलों को हाथ से हटाना छोटे बाग और छोटे पौधों में कारगर है, पर बड़े व्यावसायिक बागों में कठिन है।

items.statement_en: Train young plants to build a strong framework and avoid weak crotches.
items.statement_hi: मजबूत ढाँचा बनाने और कमजोर जोड़ों से बचने के लिए छोटे पौधों की ट्रेनिंग जरूरी है।

sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: Training of plants in young stage is essential in order to build a strong framework and to avoid weak crotches.

items.statement_en: NHB recommends pruning after harvest or in spring and avoiding summer pruning because of sunburn. CISH meadow orchards are pruned in May-June, so timing depends on the system.
items.statement_hi: एनएचबी कटाई के बाद या वसंत में छंटाई और धूप-झुलसा के कारण गर्मी में छंटाई से बचने की सलाह देता है। सीआईएसएच के मीडो बाग में मई-जून में छंटाई होती है, अतः समय प्रणाली पर निर्भर है।

sources.title: Guava (model bankable project report, one-acre model)
sources.publisher: National Horticulture Board, Govt. of India
sources.quote: Pruning is usually recommended after harvesting or in spring. Summer pruning is generally avoided as the plants get damaged due to sun burn.

conflicts.quote: All the plants are confined to a hedge shape of2 m inter row width and 2.5m height for which pruning is performed in January-February and May-June every year.

conflicts.quote: Pruning should not be performed during intense high temperatures (May, June, July), as it may cause wilting, and also not on rainy days

items.statement_en: TNAU prunes the previous season's terminal growth back to 10-15 cm in September-October and February-March to encourage laterals. Its course notes say 10-12 cm in September and February.
items.statement_hi: टीएनएयू पिछले मौसम की शाखाओं के सिरे 10-15 सेमी तक सितंबर-अक्टूबर और फरवरी-मार्च में काटने की सलाह देता है ताकि पार्श्व शाखाएँ बढ़ें।

sources.title: Horticulture :: Fruits :: Guava (Agritech portal)
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
sources.quote: Pruning of past season’s terminal growth to a length of 10-15 cm is to be done during September-October and February – March to encourage more laterals.

conflicts.quote: the tips of 10-12 cm lengths of past seasons shoots are pruned during September and February every year
conflicts.note: Course notes give 10-12 cm and two months.

items.statement_en: Old unproductive but healthy trees can be rejuvenated by pollarding or cutting back to 75 cm from ground level. Course notes give 30 cm instead.
items.statement_hi: पुराने अनुत्पादक पर स्वस्थ पेड़ों को जमीन से 75 सेमी तक काटकर (पोलार्डिंग) पुनर्जीवित किया जा सकता है। टीएनएयू नोट्स में यह 30 सेमी है।

sources.title: Horticulture :: Fruits :: Guava (Agritech portal)
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
sources.quote: Old unproductive but healthy trees can be rejuvenated may be either pollarded or cut back to 75 cm from ground level

conflicts.source_title: HORT181 Lecture 14: Guava - soil, climate, irrigation and nutrient management
conflicts.quote: the branches are pollarded leaving 30 cm in length at their origin.
conflicts.note: Course notes leave 30 cm.

items.statement_en: In CISH high-density orchards, top plants at 60-70 cm above ground two to three months after planting. The same bulletin's flow chart says one to two months.
items.statement_hi: सीआईएसएच के उच्च घनत्व बाग में रोपाई के दो-तीन माह बाद पौधों को जमीन से 60-70 सेमी पर काटें। इसी बुलेटिन का फ्लो चार्ट एक-दो माह बताता है।

sources.title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
sources.publisher: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow

conflicts.source_title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
conflicts.quote: Top the trees at a height of 60 - 70 cm from the ground level after 1-2 months of planting
conflicts.note: Flow chart in the same bulletin gives 1-2 months.

items.statement_en: Formative pruning selects 3-4 well-spaced branches as the main scaffold limbs.
items.statement_hi: आकार देने वाली छंटाई में मुख्य ढाँचे की शाखाओं के रूप में 3-4 अच्छी दूरी वाली शाखाएँ चुनी जाती हैं।

items.statement_en: CISH confines high-density trees to a hedge 2 m wide between rows and 2.5 m tall, pruning in January-February and May-June each year.
items.statement_hi: सीआईएसएच उच्च घनत्व बाग के पेड़ों को कतारों के बीच 2 मी चौड़ी और 2.5 मी ऊँची बाड़ के आकार में रखता है; छंटाई हर वर्ष जनवरी-फरवरी और मई-जून में।

items.statement_en: In a CISH meadow orchard, after the first year shoot pruning is done in May-June, September-October and January-February.
items.statement_hi: सीआईएसएच के मीडो बाग में पहले वर्ष के बाद शाखाओं की छंटाई मई-जून, सितंबर-अक्टूबर और जनवरी-फरवरी में की जाती है।

sources.title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
sources.publisher: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow
sources.quote: After a year, pruning operation is done especially in May-June, September-October and January-February.

items.statement_en: In a meadow orchard, top all trees at 30-40 cm above ground one to two months after planting.
items.statement_hi: मीडो बाग में रोपाई के एक-दो माह बाद सभी पौधों को जमीन से 30-40 सेमी पर काटा जाता है।

sources.title: High Density and Meadow Orcharding of Guava (Extension Bulletin 35)
sources.publisher: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow

items.statement_en: After topping, new shoots grow 3-4 months and are cut back to 50% of their length; the cycle repeats to build the canopy.
items.statement_hi: कटाई के बाद नई शाखाएँ 3-4 माह बढ़ने दी जाती हैं और उनकी लंबाई का 50% काटा जाता है; ढाँचा बनाने के लिए यह चक्र दोहराया जाता है।

items.statement_hi: खुला केंद्र या विलंबित खुला केंद्र प्रशिक्षण प्रणाली आमतौर पर अनुशंसित है।

items.statement_en: Do not prune in intense heat (May-July) or on rainy days because of wilting and fungal attack.

sources.quote: Remove the side shoots which appear from the base of the plant up to a height of 50-75 cms.

items.statement_en: TNAU course notes say dried twigs and branches are removed and cut ends may be treated with Bordeaux paste. HIGH risk: fungicide, needs expert and CIB&RC check.
items.statement_hi: टीएनएयू नोट्स के अनुसार सूखी टहनियाँ हटाकर कटे सिरों पर बोर्डो पेस्ट लगाया जा सकता है। उच्च जोखिम: फफूंदनाशक, विशेषज्ञ और सीआईबी एंड आरसी जाँच आवश्यक।

sources.publisher: TNAU eAgri course notes
sources.quote: Dried twigs and branches have to be removed and the cut ends may be applied with Bordeaux paste.

items.statement_en: NHB recommends 600 g N, 300 g P and 300 g K per plant per year for the Western Region. It does not state tree age, which states the Western Region covers, or whether the figures are nutrient or fertiliser weight.

conflicts_index.summary: Maximum altitude: NHB 1,500 m vs TNAU and TNAU notes 1,000 m.
Soil pH upper limit: NHB and Vikaspedia 8.2 vs TNAU notes 7.5.
Spacing: 6 x 6 m (CISH, NHB, Sonawane), 5-6 m (TNAU), 5 x 5 m (TNAU notes), 5-8 m (NHB range), 4 x 3 m (Arka Kiran).
Meadow orchard spacing: CISH 2 x 1 m; one cited study favours 2 x 2 m for quality.
Planting season: NHB June-July, TNAU June-December, CISH any time with irrigation.
Pit size and filling: 1 m (NHB), 75/50/40 cm (CISH), 60 cm (Vikaspedia), 45 cm (TNAU); FYM 10-20 kg and SSP 0.5-1 kg per pit.
Intercropping: three years (NHB text) vs four years (NHB costing).
Arka Kiran 20 t per acre vs CISH 12-20 t per ha for traditional orchards.
Summer pruning for winter crop: Odisha trial found no benefit; IJAH review cites May pruning as helpful.
Flowering months: TNAU notes April-May and August-September vs Odisha March-April and July-August.
NAA deblossoming concentration: 80-100 ppm (review), 200-400 ppm (TNAU notes), 600 ppm (review, other study).
Pruning in summer: NHB and review advise avoiding it; CISH prunes in May-June.
Tip pruning: TNAU 10-15 cm vs TNAU notes 10-12 cm.
Rejuvenation cut height: 75 cm (TNAU) vs 30 cm (TNAU notes).
Topping timing within CISH bulletin: two-three months vs one-two months after planting.
Annual NPK per plant: NHB Western 600/300/300 g vs TNAU 1 kg each plus 50 kg FYM.
Fertiliser timing: NHB June-July and October vs TNAU March and October vs CISH June and September.
Boron: 0.3% borax at flowering (TNAU) vs 0.4% boric acid pre-flowering (NHB).
Bearing tree irrigation interval: NHB 10-15 d summer, 20-25 d winter; CISH 7-10 d and 25 d; TNAU notes 10 d; Vikaspedia 5-7 d.
Young plant irrigation: CISH every second day in week one; TNAU third day then 10 days; Vikaspedia every 4-5 days in month one.
Drip water saving: CISH 40-50% vs NHB about 60%.
